splash.title: Times Table Islands
splash.tagline: Build a world of blocks while you learn the times tables

onboarding.languageSubtitle: You can change it later in settings
onboarding.customizeSubtitle: Pick your colors and an accessory

map.title: Archipelago Map
map.subtitle: Pick an island to explore
map.lockedHint: Finish the {{table}} times table to open this island

bridge.title: The broken bridge
bridge.brief: The river cut the path! Let's rebuild the bridge, block by block.
bridge.done: The bridge is finished! Now we can cross.

tower.title: The great tower
tower.brief: Every correct answer raises one more layer of the tower.
tower.done: The tower stands tall and you can see the whole archipelago!

lighthouse.title: The dark lighthouse
lighthouse.brief: The lighthouse stopped shining. Let's fix it piece by piece.
lighthouse.done: The lighthouse is lit! Its beam sweeps over the sea.

trees.title: Plant the grove
trees.brief: This part of the island is empty. Let's plant some block trees.
trees.done: The grove grew full of leaves!

house.title: The block house
house.brief: Someone needs a home. Let's build a colorful house.
house.done: The house is ready and the chimney is already puffing!

gate.title: The locked gate
gate.brief: A giant gate blocks the way. Every correct answer opens a piece.
gate.done: The gate swung open! The path is clear.

boat.title: The block boat
boat.brief: Let's build a boat to sail to the next beach.
boat.done: The boat is afloat and the sail is up!

fence.title: The farm fence
fence.brief: The wind knocked the fence down. Let's raise every post.

windmill.title: The still windmill
windmill.brief: The windmill needs new blades to spin again.
windmill.done: The windmill is spinning in the wind!

crystal.title: The crystal tower
crystal.brief: A giant crystal can light up the whole island. Let's build it!
crystal.done: The crystal glowed and lit up everything around!

game.quitMessage: Your progress in this mission will not be saved, but the islands you already finished stay yours.

tutorial.step2: Every correct answer places blocks in the scene.
tutorial.step3: Finish the build to complete the mission!

wrong.1: So close! Give it another go.
wrong.2: Not that one. Check the hint!
wrong.3: Try once more, you've got this!

islandComplete.title: Island complete!
islandComplete.subtitle: You mastered the {{table}} times table!
islandComplete.allDone: You finished the whole archipelago! Congratulations!
islandComplete.keepPracticing: A few facts will come back so you can keep practicing.
